argv:
import json, pathlib
m = json.loads(pathlib.Path("harness-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert m["release"]["version"] == "3.1.0" and m["release"]["required_tag"] == "v3.1.0", m["release"]
fm = pathlib.Path("README.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("---")[1].splitlines()
assert "version: 3.1.0" in fm, fm
ch = pathlib.Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
top = ch.split("\n## ")[1]
assert top.startswith("3.1.0 (2026-10-"), top[:30]
assert "v3.1.0" in top
lines = top.splitlines()
new = ["6. **Native-only doors:** freeze-v2 refuses, and resolve_v2 skips, a door that is not native to the seat family; re-freeze any v2 fleet that binds a foreign model on agy before dispatch.", "### Phase 2A features F010 to F013", "- F010 capability unlock: every adapter runs its full native toolset under provider contract 9; Claude keeps the deny-list and --strict-mcp-config, Codex keeps workspace-write with network and live web search and cua_repl/node_repl off per run, and probe-seat.sh diffs each CLI --help flag list.", "- F011 drive-cli hardening: after one answered trust prompt, any later prompt-like pane and every numbered or menu approval prompt stops with exit 3, and no input is sent.", "- F012 release 3.1.0 candidate: harness-manifest.json, README frontmatter and this CHANGELOG say 3.1.0 / v3.1.0 together, and the docs/RELEASING.md checks pass.", "- F013 native-only fleet: launcher prompts give goal, resources, budget and acceptance checks; Claude Code runs delegate wide reading to the Haiku explorer subagent; receipts record subagent calls and their tokens; the load-sensitive tests pass 5/5 under load; compiled-module and stdlib shadowing are scope violations.", "- Native-only rule: a door never serves a model from another vendor, so the agy Opus, Sonnet and GPT-OSS bindings are gone, and a move to another vendor is an explicit choice of another approved native seat.", "- Effort by role: brain seats (brain, brain_codex, brain_argon) run at high effort; review and worker seats run at medium effort.", "- Residual risks (docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/evidence/claude-unlock-residual-risk.md): a command that evades --disallowedTools can still read, exfiltrate or change paths outside the workspace, and the post-run snapshot detects changes only to the listed protected paths and Git workspace and index state."]
for line in new:
    assert line in lines, "missing CHANGELOG line: " + line[:60]
for tok in ("### Migration: read this before you update a consumer", "### What changes", "### Known limits", "native doors only),"):
    assert tok in top, tok
assert "chair resolution on" not in top, "stale agy chair wording in the 3.1.0 entry"
assert lines.index(new[0]) < lines.index("### What changes") < lines.index(new[1]) < lines.index("### Known limits") < lines.index(new[-1]), "CHANGELOG lines out of place"
assert pathlib.Path("docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/evidence/claude-unlock-residual-risk.md").is_file()
fleet = json.loads(pathlib.Path("docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/fleet.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
for name, seat in fleet["seats"].items():
    want = "high" if name.startswith("brain") else "medium"
    assert seat["effort"] == seat["approved_resolution"]["effort"] == want, (name, seat["effort"])
assert {s["family"] for s in fleet["seats"].values() if s["approved_resolution"]["provider"] == "agy"} <= {"flash", "argon"}
print("ok")
git ls-files -z '*.json' | xargs -0 -n 1 sh -c 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m json.tool "$1" >/dev/null' sh
git diff --check && git diff --check HEAD~1 HEAD
